projects.name: Supervisor Runtime
projects.description: The MCP Bridge, Supervisor Brain, Workflow Runtime, Harness, and product documentation.
defaultConstraints: Preserve the Harness, approval, audit, Task Runtime, and Workflow Runtime boundaries.
Do not introduce a database, front-end framework, or additional Agent runtime.
Keep changes localized and maintain Windows PowerShell operation.

projects.name: Dogfood Study Board
projects.description: A small browser task board used for bounded feature-change dogfood.
defaultConstraints: Keep the application dependency-free and browser-only.
Preserve existing task data and localStorage behavior unless the request explicitly changes it.
Limit changes to the registered task-board directory.

projects.name: Supervisor Dashboard
projects.description: The local approval, workflow status, event, artifact, and diff console.
defaultConstraints: Do not introduce React, Vue, or another front-end framework.
Keep the Dashboard observational and route state changes through the existing local product API.
Do not bypass Workflow approval or call the Harness directly.

projects.name: Autonomous Beta Demo
projects.description: An isolated dependency-free release checklist used only for Supervisor autonomous beta validation.
defaultConstraints: Keep the demo dependency-free and browser-only.
Limit all inspection and changes to workspace/autonomous-beta-demo.
Preserve the existing status filter, completion counts, and seeded checklist data.

projects.name: Release Beta Todo Demo
projects.description: An isolated dependency-free Todo application used only for Supervisor v1.0-beta release acceptance.
defaultConstraints: Keep the demo dependency-free and browser-only.
Limit all inspection and changes to workspace/release-beta-todo-demo.
Preserve the existing status filter, visible and completion counts, seeded Todo data, and responsive layout.
